evidence.detail: Grid.sort() only calls setState({sortBy, sortOrder}); no localStorage or cookie write
Initial sortBy/sortOrder come purely from props.initialSortBy/initialSortOrder; nothing reads persisted state
initialSortBy='quality' is hard-coded; page reload always resets sort to quality/AUTO

triage.fix_sketch: In `shared_web/static/js/grid.jsx`: (1) override `sort()` to also write `{sortBy, sortOrder}` to `localStorage` under a fixed key (e.g. `'metagame-sort'`), and (2) in the constructor read from localStorage to override the prop-supplied initial values. In `metagamegrid.jsx` pass the localStorage-read values as `initialSortBy`/`initialSortOrder`. ~15 lines total across those two files.
triage.notes: Season switch and tournament-only toggle both cause a full page reload, so localStorage is the right persistence layer. No backend changes needed.
